title: Vīrasat
subtitle: The Heritage
description: Virāsat is an annual celebration of India's living cultural traditions, hosted by  SPIC MACAY - IndicSense IIITDMK .Bringing together eminent gurus and master artists from the worlds of classical music and dance, folk traditions, crafts, and painting Virāsat offers a rich confluence of performances, immersive intensives, and meaningful artist interactions that introduce participants to the depth, beauty, and continuity of Bharatiya art forms.
highlights: Hands-on intensives giving firsthand experience of learning the craft
